episodes.title: A Girl in Trouble is a Temporary Thing
episodes.summary: Grumpy substance-abuse counselor Sam Loudermilk is forced to try to make a connection with a young addict if he wants to keep his weekly meeting space.

episodes.title: Shark Week
episodes.summary: With nowhere left to turn, a worse for wear Claire lands on Loudermilk's couch. Deciding she needs to be taught a lesson, he and Ben take her on their version of a vision quest. Loudermilk also makes a play for his new neighbor, Allison.

episodes.title: You're Only as Sick as Your Secrets
episodes.summary: Loudermilk goes to great lengths to get Claire to open up about her deep-seated issues, with mixed results. Mugsy reaches out to his estranged daughter and finds that some relationships are harder to fix than others.

episodes.title: It's All About the Beans
episodes.summary: Loudermilk is fed up with Claire's couch crashing and wants her gone, but her mother bribes him to continue to keep an eye on her daughter. Roger's conflicted when his old rock band is approached to use their music in a beer commercial.

episodes.title: There's a New Kid in Town
episodes.summary: A new member (Tom) joins the group who isn't all he appears to be. Cutter takes Tom under his wing to make sure his charge stays clean and sober, no matter what it takes. Loudermilk and Allison butt heads over her taste in music.

episodes.title: Lay, Lady, Lay
episodes.summary: Cutter continues to make Tom's life a living hell, but no matter what he tries, Tom can't shake him. When he turns to Loudermilk for help, Tom quickly finds that he's on his own.

episodes.title: Father of the Year
episodes.summary: A visit from Loudermilk's alcoholic, philandering father opens old wounds and creates new problems.

episodes.title: Invitation Only
episodes.summary: Ben's secret life catches up to him, and Loudermilk is forced to confront the fact that he may not know his best friend as well as he thinks.

episodes.title: Highway 10 Revisited
episodes.summary: Loudermilk, Ben, and Claire hit the road for New Orleans with the intention of crashing a wedding. Left to their own devices, the group goes off the rails.

episodes.title: Bourbon Street
episodes.summary: Loudermilk returns to Seattle and makes a huge decision that affects not only his life, but the lives of everyone in his world as well.

episodes.title: Everybody's Got Something to Hide Except for Me and My Monkey
episodes.summary: Loudermilk rallies the group.

episodes.title: Don't Go Away Mad (Just Go Away)
Stuck In The Middle With You
episodes.summary: Loudermilk becomes a dad. Sort of.

episodes.title: There Goes My Baby
episodes.summary: Ben shows off some unusual talents.

episodes.title: American Idiot
episodes.summary: Loudermilk and the group are challenged.

episodes.title: Hit Me Baby One More Time
episodes.summary: Members of the group explore their feminine side.

episodes.summary: Claire gets a new beau.

episodes.title: Hard For Me To Say I'm Sorry
episodes.summary: Loudermilk admits he was wrong.

episodes.summary: Loudermilk is surprised.
